blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Human rights lawyers in Mindanao welcomed a Supreme Court (SC) issuance establishing formal institutional backing for developmental and public-interest legal practice across the country. The Union of Peoples’ Lawyers in Mindanao (UPLM) hailed Administrative Matter No. 24-07-24, or the Rules on Institutionalizing Support for Developmental and Social Change Lawyering (DSC Rules), calling it a decisive move to embed pro-people legal work into the heart of the judicial system. According to the group, the new framework provides crucial institutional reinforcement for attorneys working directly with farmers, indigenous communities, laborers, and other marginalized sectors fighting for land, ancestral […]...
